# Island Capital

> Island Capital (Island Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore) helps businesses expand in Asia-Pacific without building a full team for Finance and compliance. It provides CFO partnership, regional Finance, Compliance and Structuring, delivered by senior leaders who have led Finance, strategy, and governance for global companies.

Island Capital works with businesses in an ongoing partnership or on a project basis (typically 4–12 weeks), flexible in time and scope. It is an ACRA-registered Corporate Service Provider in Singapore.

## Services

- [Fractional CFO & Performance Leadership](https://islandcapital.com.sg/services.html#fractional-cfo-performance-leadership): senior finance leadership and business partnering, as and when needed, scaled to the seasonality and stage of the business. Decision support; planning, forecasting and cash; performance leadership; reporting and board materials; integration and transition support.
- [Regional Finance & Compliance](https://islandcapital.com.sg/services.html#compliance-hq-finance): for regional operations in Asia-Pacific. HQ Finance (standardised monthly reporting suite, intercompany loans and funding, transfer pricing and treaty benefits) and compliance governance across HQ and every subsidiary (single point of contact, compliance and governance guidance, full visibility of timeline, status and risk per market).
- [Structuring, Set-up & Corporate Services](https://islandcapital.com.sg/services.html#company-setup): legal entity structure, operating model and financial model design for regional operations in Asia-Pacific, aligned to strategy, tax-efficient and compliant. Incorporation and corporate services in Singapore.

## Leadership

- Isabella Lan, Managing Director: 25+ years leading Finance, Strategy and Transformation in multinational companies including Microsoft, Unilever, Diageo, BAT, Boston Scientific and Energizer, across 6 regions and 40+ markets.
- Edmund Wuu, Director, Strategy & Business Advisory: former Bain & Company consultant; 25+ years in strategy, market entry and transformation across Asia, Europe and the Middle East.
- Mark Lea, Specialist Advisor: 50+ years in international structuring, governance and legal tax mitigation; former Director of Rothschild's Trust Companies; adviser to the Governments of Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia.
